newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 29.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Left-wing politicians worry over pro-Nato trend they see underlying a joint Franco-German co-operation and defence agreement signed on December 9, 1996, on which they say National Assembly was not given sufficient information.
-- Analysts divided over whether the Bank of France will cut rates after its monetary policy council meeting tomorrow.
-- Company failures rose 9 percent in 1996 after receeding for two years, study by reinsurance firm SFAC shows.
-- Aerospatiale and Renault to launch joint-venture to design and build light aircraft engines.
-- GAN considers restructuring plan that involves cutting up to 591 jobs, unions call brief work stoppage and demonstration outside GAN Paris headquarters today.
-- Total oil group posts a 5.6 billion franc profit for 1996, seeks to reduce refining activity and increase investments in exploration and drilling.
